51/201/1000 real XLSX downloads via the full server-paged export, server filters/totals, typed Unicode/text cells, library identity; a later-page failure is asserted at export time (no partial download)
B success survives a late A page-1 list response and a late A summary response
B failure survives a late A page-1 list response and a late A summary response
Four direct/linked bundle/BXGY cancel/confirm/takeover/removal paths
Participant edits, clear, legacy invalid direct/linked bundle refusal
Four physical quantity/usage/reward-owner/removal/queue paths

A version bump raises the chip and is pulled once by itself; with an item in the cart no pull happens; clearing the cart lets exactly one pull through
A stock counter bump with an unchanged content version is pulled once by itself with no update chip and no further pull
Variant sheet: a size row adds one unit and closes (D-10), cash sale in four taps; line sheet edits quantity, switches size (remove + add, same qty) and removes the line
One Promo & Diskon door: code field and manual Diskon inline in the same sheet, Kosongkan asks before clearing (Batal keeps the cart)

Customer chip and Pelanggan sheet: a phone search lists the match with a Profil entry; the profile shows the Bahan obrolan pitch, Ulangi adds the last sale's paid lines (never a Rp0 reward line), the gold bar attaches the customer, Lepas releases it

Outlet giveaway: a paid line shows the bag as a HADIAH / GRATIS cart line without stepper or remove, the on-screen receipt lists it, the order payload carries no bag line (the quote does, as a Rp0 reward line) and the bag's tile stock drops by one once queued

Pesanan tersimpan: Simpan keranjang names and parks the cart (no confirm, cart empties, chip shows the count), the hamburger entry opens the list, Lanjutkan restores the line and the sale is paid in cash
Rendered repeated export/cancel/share/clipboard failures retain two failed operations
Rendered denied refund park/export/reconstruction/original-key retry
Two parked sales: Coba lagi on one row re-queues only that item, the other stays parked; Tandai sudah ditangani hides a row without deleting it

Offline sale survives a reload, is found by receipt number under Struk di tablet ini, reprinted once without a new outbox entry, refunded by uuid, blocked from a second refund, then synced sale-before-refund and shown as Sudah direfund
Per-line offline sale: one unit refunded by uuid, second refund blocked while queued, synced as a partial (Sebagian direfund, sisa Rp 250.000), then the remainder refunded to Sudah direfund
Guest sale with a bundle group and giveaway bag: one group box selects both members without a stepper, the bag has no checkbox, and the group refunds together

02 A resolves while B pending

04 A success after B error

06 overlapping same-scope polls
07a manual then interval
07b interval then manual

09 unmount pending

11 A26 complete multi-page A after B

Sidebar badge, open list, detail, raw key and reason code only behind Detail teknis, resolve with trimmed note and escaped key, badge clears
CSV import dialog: preview errors block Terapkan, clean preview enables it, apply sends Idempotency-Key + dryRun false + preview hash/summary, success text

Ringkasan row opens the Kartu Stok on that SKU with the SKU and location in the URL, saldo header and Hadiah/Minus badges, cursor paging, Hadiah chip sends giveaway=true, Unduh CSV saves the server file; Pergerakan bucket columns; Garansi badge; Dokumen cell opens the goods receipt in place; Tambah barang masuk posts a warranty receipt with an Idempotency-Key, a retry reuses it and a new open sends a new one; Tambah penyesuaian shows the change line and posts with a key

Laporan > Refund: one row per refund with Refund ke-N, amount of record, claimed amount and warning badge; flag select sends flag to the API, paging sends page/limit, Unduh CSV refund pages at limit=200 and downloads the per-refund CSV

Admin per-line refund on Transaksi: bundle group is all-or-nothing, pick qty 1 on a line, reason preset, confirm modal states item and estimate, POST body is {reason, reasonCode, items:[{lineNo,quantity}]}, order then shows Refund ke-1 and the remaining refundable amount

Transaksi with a split order: list shows Split-Payment (never the raw id) and the ⚠ Bayar reason, detail lists each payment line with reference and change, the payment filter offers Split-Payment and sends it to the API, the admin refund shows payout chips for split orders only (default preselected) and posts the chosen payoutMethod, and the Unduh CSV writes the lines as "QRIS 751.000; Tunai 500.000"

Pengaturan > Transaksi: Bayar terpisah is off by default and shows the D-50 warning, switching on asks to confirm (Batal keeps it off), the reserved method id split is refused client-side, and Simpan perubahan sends splitTenderEnabled; a second save after another edit omits the untouched flag

Pengaturan: no save bar on open; an edit shows the bar and dirty cues and the sidebar asks Simpan perubahan Pengaturan? (Tetap di sini keeps the edit, Buang perubahan navigates); a save after another admin changed taxRate sends the fresh taxRate plus only the edited field and omits untouched present-only keys, with a cache-bypassing GET before and after the PUT

Routed tabs and views: #/laporan/refund survives a reload and fills the breadcrumb; a bare #/laporan or an unknown tab shows the first tab and a tab click writes the path with Back and Forward moving between tabs; #/inventori/transfer/<id> opens the detail after a reload and Kembali returns to the list; #/inventori/bahan shows the first tab until recipesEnabled loads, then lands on Bahan with the URL untouched

Leave guard with routed tabs: a dirty Pengaturan switches its own tabs and follows Back and Forward between them without asking (edit and dirty dot stay); a typed URL out of the screen asks, Tetap di sini keeps hash, history entry and edit, Buang perubahan opens it as a push; a Forward that leaves the dirty screen asks, a refused one leaves history untouched and an allowed one lands on the same entry

Kaca K2 kit and shell: the skip link is the first Tab stop and focuses main without changing the hash; Produk has exactly one scroll area and its sticky header stays at the top of main while main scrolls; Produk tabs are role=tab with aria-selected and a roving tabindex, arrows move focus without selecting, Enter selects, Home goes to the first; at 375 px the table scrolls sideways in its card with no sticky header and main never scrolls sideways; screenshots at 1440, 768 and 375

Pelanggan list filters (q, urut, hal) are URL state and request params; opening a customer is a path push; Back and Kembali return to the list with the same URL, controls and request; Forward returns to the customer; a pasted customer link has nothing to step back to so Kembali opens the list; junk urut/hal/tag/per fall back to the defaults

Pelanggan list: a captioned DataTable over the server OFFSET page (page, limit, q); search and page size are URL state that survive a reload and feed the request; the edit slide-over closes silently when untouched and asks exactly one question for Escape, the x, Batal and browser Back on unsaved work (Lanjut edit keeps the form, Buang perubahan sends nothing); a refused save keeps its reason in the panel and the retry saves; delete asks first (Batal sends nothing) and a refused delete keeps the server reason in the dialog

Bahan Daftar: the category filter is the server parameter categoryId (not a filter over one fetched page), so 60 matching ingredients span three pages and every page request carries it and shows only that category; the category is URL state, changing it returns to page 1, a reload restores the select and the request, and Semua kategori sends no parameter; delete blocks an ingredient used by a recipe (variants listed, no delete button) and otherwise asks, keeping a refused delete's server reason inside the dialog

Produk list: search, status, kategori and stok are server parameters and URL state that survive a reload, a page past the end steps back to the last page, the export walks every page of the matching products only; the editor slide-over (?ubah=) reloads by id, asks one question for Escape and browser Back on unsaved work, closes without asking after a save, shows field errors with a focusing summary and layers the recipe editor so Escape closes only the top layer; a refused delete keeps the server reason in the dialog

Promosi and Kode Diskon: search, status and jenis are server parameters and URL state that survive a reload and feed the export of every matching row, paging is a server request; the status Switch asks before turning ON (Batal writes nothing) and turning OFF saves at once with Urungkan, which re-reads and sends the fresh row; an untouched edit of a promotion and of a code sends every stored field back (outlets not in the list, null minimum, mixed-case code, null quota, holder); a refused save, delete or Buat Massal keeps the server reason visible; Simpan in the editor asks the same question only when it makes the item active (a new active promotion, an inactive one turned on; Batal keeps the form and sends nothing; an already-active edit does not ask) and Duplikat creates the copy inactive; Buat Massal asks "Buat N kode aktif?" with the requested count before creating active codes (Batal keeps the panel and its form, sends nothing, and leaves a refusal visible; a confirm followed at once by a second Generate click asks nothing more and sends exactly one batch with that count; the question starts with focus on Batal; a batch answered 503 is retried from the same panel with the SAME Idempotency-Key (also after closing and reopening the panel, which keeps its form), the success reports "N kode dibuat" and downloads the code CSV, and a panel reopened after a success sends a NEW key)

Transfer detail: Kirim opens a question naming the unit count and the source and sends nothing; Batal leaves the draft; a refused send keeps the dialog open with the reason and the retry carries the same Idempotency-Key while a reopened dialog gets a new one; a transfer cancelled by another user under the open Batalkan dialog is refused with no write; Batalkan states that the stock returns, and a double click on the confirm calls the write exactly once with a key of its own

Product Opname: Mulai opens a question and Batal leaves the count planned, confirming starts it once; Selesai saves an unsaved edit first and states the net difference of the saved count (10 to 4 and 5 to 6 is -5) and Batal completes nothing, confirming completes once; the cancel button asks, Kembali sends nothing and confirming cancels once; ingredient Opname: Simpan with nothing entered sends nothing, and Simpan after entering one of three ingredients sends exactly that one line (not the saved or the uncounted ones) so Selesai cannot zero them

Shared product-catalogue cache: Opname, Ringkasan and Pelanggan fetch the whole product list once instead of every 12 s while idle (30 s fake clock), Tambah opname snapshots stock from a fresh read (7 to 3), and Ringkasan order numbers keep their 12 s poll and read Rp 300.000 throughout

Ringkasan reads the server aggregate: one request per 12 s poll, no order list downloaded, Penjualan Rp 300.000 and Transaksi 3 before and after 30 s idle, and Semua asks the aggregate about once a minute (none inside its first 30 s, at most two in 100 s); against a backend without the route (404) it probes once, falls back to the order lists with the same numbers and keeps their 12 s poll

Persetujuan Stok: the Jenis and Outlet filters are server parameters and URL state that survive a reload, and the sidebar badge requests never carry a filter so the badge stays put; Integrasi ERP: the status is URL state (Semua is its own value), locations show names, Kirim sekarang asks first (Batal sends nothing) and a double click on the confirm runs the relay once, the run reads as Terkirim, Ditahan and Gagal counts with setting names only behind Detail teknis, and Kirim ulang asks first and a double click retries the opened document once

Laporan Kode Diskon on the kit Pagination: the fixed page size offers one size and reaches the API as limit=50, Berikutnya writes hal=2 and asks page=2, and page 2 survives a reload and Back from another tab

Pengguna role delete opens a ConfirmDialog that names the role and sends nothing until confirmed; a refused delete (409) keeps the dialog open with the server reason and was sent once; Batal closes it

Cashier Permintaan Barang: menu hidden without request_stock; create sends Idempotency-Key and outlet; a failed submit retries with the same key; transfer chain shows Dikirim and Buka Terima Transfer opens the receive panel; cancel a draft; a lost create answer then an edit replays the old key (one PB, then one update) and is resolved when the panel next opens online; offline refuses the save with no request leaving the tablet; zero approve/reject/fulfil requests across the run

Split payment: QRIS 60.000 with a reference plus cash 50.000 with change 10.000 on a Rp 100.000 cart; the receipt lists one row per line, the order payload carries the split summary scalars and tenders, the snapshot carries the lines and change, and Struk di tablet ini reads Split-Payment with both lines
An offline split sale is queued on the tablet with its reference, survives a reload, and reaches the server with its tenders after reconnecting

A split sale is refunded: Dikembalikan lewat chips for the sale's methods with the cash line's method preselected (the queued refund carries payoutMethod), then a second sale with the QRIS chip chosen
With the splitTenderEnabled setting absent or false there is no Bagi pembayaran and the single-method checkout (with the optional reference field) is unchanged
The open cart is saved on this tablet, restored after a reload, deleted once the sale is queued; a stale draft whose sale is already queued is dropped and the paid cart never reappears

The POS catalogue scrolls under one glass band (header zone + search + categories): computed backdrop-filter on the band, exactly one blurred layer, first row uncovered at scroll 0 at 1006x601 and 1280x800, tiles pass under the band when scrolled, data-material=static removes the blur, the cart mounts with the band still the only blur
The Otomatis promo lines (tag, remove x) show in the restyled cart column

A promotion marked Otomatis enters the POS cart by itself with an Otomatis tag; the cashier's x removes it for the sale and it stays removed through a cart edit, hold + resume and a reload; + Tambah re-adds it as a normal manual promo

An unfinished split payment is saved when the first non-cash line is added, offered back after a reload and restored; the sale uses the draft's orderUuid; a draft whose sale is already queued is dropped silently with exactly one queued sale
